verdicts.reason: A: the LIMITED badge is blown up into a big pink block that outweighs the small 'Enter Now' CTA stacked above it, so the hierarchy is inverted. The subcopy wraps awkwardly to an orphaned 'Thursday.' and is tiny, and the shoe gets pushed to the far right. B: the headline and CTA lead properly, but the shoe shrinks to an almost unrecognisable sliver jammed against the LIMITED badge, and the subcopy is squeezed into a cramped 3-line column at an illegible size. B is the less bad of the two because its hierarchy is correct.
